# Which Frost

> Which Frost (whichfrost.com) lists median last spring and first fall frost dates for 341 large U.S. cities, from NOAA NCEI 1991 to 2020 climate normals, with USDA hardiness zones and state extension planting notes where transcribed. Last verified 16 Nov 2026.

## Start
- https://whichfrost.com/
- https://whichfrost.com/states/
- https://whichfrost.com/zones/
- https://whichfrost.com/methodology/
